_about.method: Real return = (1 + eq_tr) / (1 + CPI inflation) - 1, in each country's own currency. World = those returns weighted by the previous year's GDP in dollars (gdp / xrusd), with Dutch inflation and the Dutch bill rate beside them. Country-years with inflation beyond ±50% (hyperinflations, currency reforms) are dropped. Currency moves are left out: the dataset's exchange rates are annual averages, which put jumps into converted returns that never happened (it has the guilder at 6.50 to the dollar in 1946).
